description: Celestron Origin built-in colour camera (FITS CAMERA = 'Origin178-<unit id>')

measured.method: two-point photon transfer on consecutive raw lights; gain and per-channel noise floor from a fit of 1/g_measured = 1/g + floor/signal across sessions

colour.note: instrumental -2.5log10(B/R), -2.5log10(G/R) per mag of Gaia BP-RP; median of 23 linear stacks with >=30 stars at SNR>20. B-R holds to ~+-0.06 between nights; G-R varies 0.27-0.77 (night-dependent, unexplained). Used only below 15 stars, where it beat a free fit on 6-14-star subsamples.
